title: 9 Signs You Care More About a Wife Than You Do About God
caption:
You'd never say it out loud. But your prayers, your mind, and your calendar already said it for you.

The guy chasing a wife instead of God prays harder for her than for his own sin. He measures his twenties by a ring instead of by who he's becoming. He wants her to fix what only God was ever going to fix.

The guy walking with God becomes the guy worth marrying. The order matters more than the timeline.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
